text.p: Oil product inventories held in independent tankage in the Amsterdam-Rotterdam-Antwerp area were estimated to be at the following levels currently, a week ago and a year ago, industry sources said.
All figures in thousands of tonnes:
Gas oil stocks dipped slightly as product left to Benelux and headed down the Rhine to destinations including France. Some product appeared to be left from the November IPE delivery.
Gasoline stocks rose very slightly as barges arrived, but material did leave for Germany, the Mediterranean and France.
Naphtha inventories also rose marginally despite withdrawals by the German chemical sector.
Fuel oil stocks rose as material arriving from Latin America was not fully absorbed by the bunkering sector.
Jet fuel was balanced as most new product headed for the gas oil pool. -- Amsterdam Newsroom, +31 20 504 5004
